thread:
Samir Patel: Heads-up 10: ACME NYC requested a customised commitment: lower initial commit, guaranteed burst window, and a 3-month overage invoice waiver. Thinking of running a pilot. Anyone against?

Elaine Cho: paste the exact asks so we can assess scope pls

Samir Patel: From CS/AM: 
- Commit = 250k tokens/mo for first 6 months (vs standard 1M)
- Burst up to 2x committed; burst tokens billed at +30% surcharge
- 3-month grace: overage throttled but not invoiced for first 90 days (still counted)

Ben Ortiz: Technically doable. Biggest risk = setting a precedent. Need explicit pilot constraints + signoff path.

Olivia Wang: +1 on pilot. Requirements: they must opt into monthly usage tracing and run our standard perf eval. Also mark this as a "reference" only, non-transferable.

Samir Patel: Draft pilot gating I put together: 
* Scope: single-customer pilot per region, timeboxed (min 3 months).
* Success metrics: p95 latency within SLA, blended unit cost within +/-30% of forecast, no burst-attributed incidents.
* Billing: prorated committed line + separate burst line at surcharge; over-throttle events flagged but waived for 3 months.
* Legal: carveout clause; requires director-level approval to extend or generalize.

Ben Ortiz: Add rollback triggers: 2 consecutive months with >30% unit-cost delta OR any Sev2 incident attributable to burst routing => auto-roll back to standard commit shape.

Elaine Cho: Product needs: token-level tagging for bursts, quick CSV export for pilot, Console badge showing commit vs burst. Minimal Console effort first; full UI later. Estimate: ~2 sprints for tagging+CSV, +2 for badge if we generalize.

Olivia Wang: Can we avoid building badge initially and push CSV to AMs? Means less infra work.

Samir Patel: CSV + a small Console banner is acceptable for pilot. We'll delay full dashboard until we decide to productize.

Ben Ortiz: Infra question: how will we route burst traffic? If burst uses same pool, latency could spike. Recommend a pre-warmed "burst-pool" with autoscale caps so cost is predictable.

Olivia Wang: Does burst-pool imply different SLAs? Need to state that burst latency is best-effort vs committed.

Samir Patel: For hosted customers, label burst SLAs as best-effort in pilot docs. For Dedicated, different implementation but same contract language.

Elaine Cho: Dependencies list: billing line items + invoice formatting, backend token tagging + sampling, CSV generator, docs + legal clause, small Console banner. Who owns billing mapping?

Ben Ortiz: Billing team to add surcharge line & dry-run invoice generator. I'll coordinate.

Samir Patel: Timeline thought: if we prioritize, MVP pilot (CSV + tagging + billing dry-run + docs) in 3 sprints with 1 backend, 1 billing, 1 small FE touch.

Olivia Wang: Monitoring plan: weekly check-ins for first 8 weeks, cost/latency dashboard (internal), and escalation to infra if anomalies. Product-ops or Samir to run check-ins?

Samir Patel: I can run first 6 weeks. Product-ops takes over afterward if extended.

Ben Ortiz: Rollout playbook suggestion: 
1) Preflight: run perf eval and billing dry-run against their historical usage
2) Flip pilot switch (token tagging + CSV ingestion)
3) Monitor weekly; log anomalies to #eng-oncall and product-ops
4) Decision gate at 90 days: graduate / extend / rollback

launch-bot: Reminder: RFC needed by EOD Fri to appear on next planning board.

Olivia Wang: I'll draft RFC focusing on launch criteria and monitoring. Ben, add infra rollback thresholds and burst-pool notes?

Ben Ortiz: On it. Will include autoscale cap numbers and cost delta formula.

Elaine Cho: I'll scope minimal Console copy and docs. Add ACME AM contact and legal lead to RFC pls.

Samir Patel: ACME contacts: Nora (AM), Victor (Procurement). Legal lead: Priya Sharma. Adding to RFC.

Olivia Wang: Also add clause: "No customer-specific pricing carveouts without director-level approval." prevents ad-hoc promises by sales.

Samir Patel: Good call. Will include that phrase in RFC.

Ben Ortiz: Next step: 30m RFC sync tomorrow 09:30 PT with Olivia + Ben + Samir to finalize wording.

Elaine Cho: Can we tag it on roadmap as Q2 pilot: low-commit-burst (internal only)?

launch-bot: Roadmap tag added: pilot-low-commit-burst-Q2

Samir Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll upload RFC draft after our sync and link ACME contacts.
